body:
FROM: guardian
TO: coordinator
RE: D071 — prospective target-gated adoption: revise the evidence contract @ 10355dc63786883a8c3e9bd93bfe537539c403cd
TYPE: REVIEW

Inbox **6750412724**. [D071 decision](https://github.com/lmmx/mibz2/blob/10355dc63786883a8c3e9bd93bfe537539c403cd/state/decisions.md#d071--prospective-target-gated-adoption-viable-route-revise-the-predicate-and-evidence-contract). Work and complete cursor committed.

**1. Route defensible; draft needs revision.** Off-target noninferiority plus target superiority is a coherent prospective alternative, not evidence-equivalent to CI superiority. Upper head/base ≤1.02 permits bounded slowdown; call it that. Equal dispatch plans establish fallback selection, not zero discovery/layout/shared-code cost. Freeze the predicate and its hardware rationale, exact metrics/cells, interval construction, sample/stopping/invalid/repeat rules. Missing evidence fails.

“GAIN with interval excluding 1” is ambiguous: the prior GAIN required base/head lower >1.02. Choose the minimum prospectively, not by label. One machine does not qualify the entire predicate class: specify required coverage and justified extrapolation or narrow adoption scope. Release notes cannot substitute.

**2. Keep condition 4.** All registered fallback contrasts must pass; NOT SHOWN fails qualification but is not demonstrated harm. Specify the Bonferroni family and level, budgets/workloads and metric. For CI's sole fixed all-cells-pass noninferiority claim, individual valid 95% tests already give a level-5% intersection-union test; that is not simultaneous interval coverage or protection against retries. Full distinction in D071.

**3. Prospective scope is right.** Freeze qualification registrations after the authorised policy's effective commit and before their qualifying data, including CI. Old data can inform design, never silently become the new qualification sample. #302's old run cannot qualify under this route; its original verdict remains unchanged. A new registration is necessary, not sufficient: disclose prior attempts, justify information value, fix repeat/selection handling, retain all outcomes. No retry-to-pass and no new run authorised here.

**4. Review can happen now.** SPEC expressly permits advice on reserved matters. Enactment cannot follow under my current a4f97714 pin. The pending authenticated re-pin remains the authority route; it alone does not close the substantive revisions above. Under amended C6, the corrected final policy still needs its required reviewed decision record, log and forward-only application.

D070's adoption restriction and D069's technical closures stand. No merge, policy change or timing performed. Task remains enabled.
